prompt:
Design a 5 V nominal red indicator LED circuit targeting 2-4 mA with exactly one series current-limiting resistor. Assume LED forward voltage 1.8-2.2 V. Use references R1, D1, VIN, GND and OUT. Pins are R1 A/B, D1 A/K, VIN 1, GND 1, OUT 1. Provide the complete exact pin-to-net graph and values; include nets VIN, LED_NODE and GND. OUT is an optional observation port on the LED anode node. Return JSON only using the supplied response schema.
Response schema: {"topology":"string","components":[{"ref":"string","kind":"resistor|capacitor|led|timer555|port|ground","value":"string or null","pins":["string"]}],"nets":[{"name":"string","terminals":["REF.pin"]}]}
